worldcombat.skill.explosion.summary: Attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion, and the user faints upon using it. Foes in the ring are hurled outward and lifted, and the ground is left with a charred crater; even a blast that hits no one takes the user down. Charged blast is bigger and longer, snap blast is faster.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.use.0: Trade one life to badly hurt a whole ring
worldcombat.skill.explosion.use.1: Hurl every close foe far outward
worldcombat.skill.explosion.use.2: Gamble the heaviest blow before foes can step away
worldcombat.skill.explosion.use.3: Leave a lasting crater before going down
Each target in the ring takes about %1$s explosion damage; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit (a Ghost is immune to the blow, but the user still faints).
The blast reaches %1$s blocks; that ring is the ground it covers.
Those caught are hurled %1$s blocks outward and lifted at %2$s blocks/tick.
Change up to %2$s ground blocks and restore them after %1$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.charged.on: Charged blast: power about x1.12, the blast spreads x1.12 and the crater lasts x1.6, at wind-up +6 and cooldown +14 (a longer interruptible window).
worldcombat.skill.explosion.charged.off: Snap blast: power about x0.95, the blast narrows to x0.95 and cooldown is -8, so it comes out faster and the crater is shorter.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP and a %4$s s cooldown is committed on cast. The user faints once it is used.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.growth.0: At level %1$s the blast rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.preference.c: On (charged blast): power about x1.12, the blast spreads x1.12 and the crater lasts x1.6, at wind-up +6 and cooldown +14 - the longer you charge the more you get, but the easier it is to interrupt. Off (snap blast): power about x0.95, the blast narrows to x0.95 and cooldown is -8, so it comes out faster with a shorter crater. Either way the user goes down.
worldcombat.skill.explosion.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion will not walk in to detonate; it is a move for inside the ring.
At least this many visible, living targets must stand in the ring before it detonates; raise it for surrounded-only use, set it to 1 to detonate at a single target.
Below this fraction of its own health the companion lowers the detonation threshold to one target; higher makes it go down fighting sooner.
